write_up: You moved from personal banking into branch management at Magnolia Community Bank. The management work has the numbers a recruiter needs, though the time since your last dated role leaves a question before they get to it.

The deposit growth line is your best model: it names the business result, the starting and ending amounts, and the period. Experience is also in the right place above Education. Nothing on the resume accounts for the time after December 2024.
Let's start with that recent time, then add detail to the audit and customer complaint lines. Your branch management story is already there; those additions can help a recruiter stay focused on it.
